The runner Auto Scaling group can launch instances as soon as its launch configuration exists, but the instance role's docker-machine permissions may still be attaching. Make the group wait for this attachment so the runner agent has the permissions it needs at startup.

----------------------------------------

[final-gpt-6-luna-effort-high-run3]

----------------------------------------

[merged-glm-5.3-flash-atleast2of3]
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance launches the runner agent instance whose user-data script writes the runner token into the SSM parameter module.runner:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token (referenced only by name via local.secure_parameter_store_runner_token_key, no attribute reference). The parameter must exist before the instance boots, otherwise the user-data script cannot store the runner token and Terraform's ownership of the parameter is broken.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
`module.runner:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.gitlab_runner_instance` boots the runner agent instance whose user-data script manages the value of `module.runner:resource.aws_ssm_parameter.runner_registration_token` (writing the registered runner token into it at boot). The ASG has no dependency on the SSM parameter (the user_data template only embeds the parameter *name* as a string), so the instance can launch and its user-data script can run before the parameter exists.
